requirements.text: Sign-up writes the account to the ANTICODEX ledger (public.users, or data/db.json on the desktop/offline), salts+hashes the password with scrypt, and returns a live session — so a normal @gmail.com address gets in even when the project has no SMTP, is rate limited, or Supabase is unreachable.

Supabase Auth is mirrored best-effort through its public endpoints (POST /signup, POST /recover, POST /verify), which need only the anon key; /admin/ calls (used to sync a changed password) are authenticated with Authorization: Bearer — putting the key only in apikey is what used to fail sign-up with “This endpoint requires a Bearer token”.
Set REQUIREEMAILVERIFICATION=true; the sign-up screen then asks for the emailed 6-digit code (or the emailed link) before the account opens.
